messages.subject: Re: Can I sort factor loadings in the EFA model?
parts:
Depends on how you want them sorted (e.g., by communality, by factor magnitude, by factor....etc), but for now you'd have to do it manually.

mod <- mirt(Science, 2)
so <- summary(mod)
so$rotF #sort this object by rows

Phil
